test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the census 2011, what percentage of India accounts for the world population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**17.5%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Census 2011:-**

 
 
• **India's population accounted for around 17.5 percent of the world's total population.**
 
• The census conducted in 2011 revealed that India's population was 1,210,854,977, making it the second most populated country in the world after China.
 
• India's population has grown steadily over the years, and it is projected to continue growing in the coming decades.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urbanization: **

 
 
• The census revealed that India's urbanization rate had increased from 27.7% in 2001 to 31.2% in 2011.
 
• This indicates a growing trend of people moving from rural to urban areas in search of better opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Literacy Rate:**
 
 
• The overall literacy rate of India improved from 62.3% in 2001 to 74.04% in 2011.
 
• This progress was particularly evident among women, whose literacy rate rose from 54.16% to 65.46%.
 
 
 
• **Child Sex Ratio: **
 
 
• As per the Census, 2011 the child sex ratio (0-6 years) has shown a decline from 927 females per thousand males in 2001 to 919 females per thousand males in 2011.
 
 
 
• **Religious Composition: **
 
 
• Hindus continued to form the majority of the population, accounting for 79.8% of the total.
 
• Muslims constituted the second largest religious group, representing 14.23%.
